name: τ-bench 2.0 (tau2-bench)
summary: Sierra Research's MIT τ-bench 2.0: tool-agent-user customer-service tasks in six languages, text and voice, with a live leaderboard at taubench.com.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Sierra Research). The sierra-research/tau2-bench repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2025 Sierra Research), not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-21. Homepage listed on GitHub: https://www.taubench.com (that host 301s to http://taubench.com/; use https://taubench.com, HTTP 200). This is τ-bench 2.0, distinct from the already-listed original tau-bench. The README describes τ-i18n / τ-multi: the same customer-service tasks in six languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Chinese and Korean), in text and in full-duplex voice, plus post-hoc judges for how the agent speaks; language packs localize tasks, database and caller personas for airline, retail and telecom. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07982 (HTTP 200). Sierra blog: https://sierra.ai/blog/benchmarking-agents-in-collaborative-real-world-scenarios (HTTP 200). The pack is free to use under MIT. Running the benchmark may call paid model APIs; no eval run or spend was performed.

agent_access.notes: Public MIT benchmark repository and leaderboard. Documented eval commands were not executed. A live run may call third-party model APIs and incur their charges; no key or spend was used. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint. Use https://taubench.com (www.taubench.com 301s to http and is not cited).
